title: The Files tab lists the tree on a conversation made with New session, without a page reload
steps: S1: From vendor/tracy/dsh-better-sidebar run: npx vitest run tests/native-body-session-cwd.spec.tsx
S2: Read the exit code, the failed count and the four test titles named below.
S3: Read src/client/native/tab-adapter.tsx and src/client/Sidebar.tsx and find how each gets the session's cwd.
expect: 'asks the host for the cwd of a session whose summary has none (a New session)' passes: with a list summary that has no cwd, the native tab body calls session.cwd once with that sessionId and the plugin tab's scope.cwd becomes the host's answer.
'uses the summary cwd without asking the host' and 'takes the summary cwd once it arrives' pass: a summary cwd is used without calling the host, and wins over the host's answer once it arrives.
'keeps the cwd undefined while the host has not answered, and when it refuses' passes: one call, scope.cwd stays undefined, no error thrown.
S3: both tab-adapter.tsx and Sidebar.tsx import useSessionCwd from session-cwd.ts, and tab-adapter.tsx defines no useSessionCwd of its own.
evidence: Files tab on a New session drew 'Select a conversation to use the sidebar' and never listed the tree until a reload (scope.cwd undefined; no fs.trees, git.status sent without cwd). The first and fourth spec tests were red on the base (session.cwd never called).
fence: Mechanism only, no stand: the real NativeTabBody renders under vitest with a fake client session list and a mocked session.cwd. Not covered: the live host answering session.cwd, the Files tree painting in a real browser.
